title: APICircle Environment
description: YAML projection of a single APICircle environment. Variables travel through Git; encrypted values decrypt at request-send time using the workspace passphrase.

name.description: Environment name — must be unique within the workspace

encrypted.description: When true, value is ciphertext (enc:v1:<iv>:<ct>) decrypted with the workspace passphrase

secretKeyId.description: Slot id in WorkspaceSynced.secretKeys — required when encrypted is true
